## `client.raw`

The folders and files under `raw/`, to choose an external table's location.

The `raw` resource of the platform API.

### `client.raw.list`

Signature: `client.raw.list(environment: str, path: str = 'raw', *, limit: int | None = None, cursor: str | None = None) -> RawPage`

List one page of a folder of `raw/`: its folders and files, in key order.

Needs `CREATE_TABLE` on some namespace of the environment; each folder read is recorded in the audit log.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment. |
| `path` | `str` | `'raw'` | The folder: ``"raw"`` or a folder below it, such as ``"raw/orders"``. |
| `limit` | `int | None` | `None` | Most entries returned (1 to 200); `None` leaves it to the server (100). |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor`. |

Returns: `RawPage`. The entries, and the cursor of the next page (`None` on the last).

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If you may register an external table in no namespace of the environment. |
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment does not exist. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `path` is not `raw` or a folder below it. |

### `client.raw.iter`

Signature: `client.raw.iter(environment: str, path: str = 'raw', *, page_size: int = 100) -> Iterator[RawEntry]`

Yield every entry of a folder of `raw/`, fetching pages as needed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment. |
| `path` | `str` | `'raw'` | The folder. |
| `page_size` | `int` | `100` | Entries per request (1 to 200). |

Returns: `Iterator of RawEntry`. Each entry, once.
